en.title: Europe's Accessibility Act One Year On: Companies Lag Behind Compliance
en.summary: One year after the European Accessibility Act took effect, many businesses still lag in compliance, according to recent reports. Meanwhile, new accessibility-focused product launches include a Figma plugin for geometric wireframes and the Jackpotter platform’s accessibility emphasis. Additionally, discussion continues on reserving accessible ramps for those who need them.

highlights.title: One Year After European Accessibility Act Takes Effect, Companies Lag in Compliance
Accessible ramps should be reserved for those who need them!

zh-TW.title: 歐洲無障礙法案一年 合規落後
zh-TW.summary: 歐洲無障礙法案上路已滿一年，但許多企業仍未達標。同時，新推出的無障礙產品包括NodeShape Studio Figma外掛與Jackpotter平台，皆著重可及性設計。此外，討論強調應將無障礙坡道保留給真正需要的人使用。

highlights.title: 無障礙坡道應該留給有需要的人！
歐洲無障礙法案上路一年 企業追趕進度仍落後 - 商傳媒
NodeShape Studio Figma 外掛程式發布
